title: REPORT on the annual report on the activities of the European Ombudsman in 2024
part_text: 6. Stresses that the Commission should improve the rules on the substitution of hazardous substances in pesticides in order to better take into account effective, safe non-chemical alternatives; insists on the need for a coherent and effective regulatory framework to ensure that no product from a non-EU country competes with domestic EU production if it contains hazardous substances that are banned in the EU; is deeply concerned about the lack of sufficient guarantees regarding the traceability of and the health checks performed on products from non-EU countries; calls on the Commission to ensure that the approval process is fully transparent and follows strict safeguards against conflicts of interest, duly taking into account the Ombudsman’s suggestions for improvement;
